findings.finding: The environment's git commit wrapper appends Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com> even when the commit message does not. This packet forbids AI attribution; the four work-unit commit messages were rewritten to drop those trailers. Content hashes of the trees were unchanged.
findings.evidence: Original 70c3abe-predecessor be81b76 body contained Co-authored-by; git log -4 after filter-branch shows no trailer.
findings.affects: Any apply packet that forbids Co-authored-by trailers.
